{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0241","text":"Rook 2.0 cert gate go/no-go: Mariam, Abebe, Omar. 60 min. BRING BURNDOWN."},{"spec_id":"spec_0242","text":"Hey y'all! Pavel here. Now that the Project Jasper spring cleanup is in the books, I'd like to round up the crew for a retro before the details go fuzzy on us. Thursday 2-3pm, back room or Zoom, whichever suits you.

I've already penciled in who's covering what so we don't wander all over the pasture:

- Volunteer turnout numbers vs. our goal (Elena Vasquez). She's got the sign-in sheets tallied, 212 folks against a goal of 250.
- Supply costs and what we overbought (Priya Kariuki). We ended up with about 40 extra boxes of trash bags, so that's next year sorted.
- Partner feedback from the hardware store and the school (Zoe Haddad). She's collected their emails and they're mostly sunshine.
- Parking/shuttle hiccups Saturday morning (Uriel Rasmussen). He's writing up what happened at the north lot and the fix for next time.
- Photo and social recap (Teo Vasquez)
- Grant reporting deadline and what the funder needs from each of us (Dana Ishikawa). It's due the 30th.

Each owner, if you'd jot your piece into the shared doc ahead of time, that'd be mighty helpful. Then we can just walk through it together. I figure 8-10 minutes apiece gets us out on time.

I know it's an hour out of a busy week, but I always feel better when we've all heard the same story at the same table. Holler if Thursday's a bust for you and I'll see what I can rustle up. Coffee's on me. 🙂"},{"spec_id":"spec_0243","text":"Opal migration – cutover decision!! 🚀 (30 min, 5 ppl)
1. Abebe: carrier API still failing 3%. Go or we wait? (10 min)
2. Keiko: rollback plan, need everyone agree on it (10 min)
3. Liam + Jamal: choose weekend for cutover, Sat or Sun (10 min)
We must to leave with decision, so exciting!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0244","text":"Subject: Northpath site stakeholder review – Tue 10:00-10:30
